added.summary: A screen's root matches `:active-view-transition` from the frame its layer's view transition starts until it ends, so `:active-view-transition .card { … }` styles the screen during the transition. `:active-view-transition-type(slide)` matches when the screen's `@view-transition { types: slide; }` declares one of the types; it now works in any rule, not only before a `::view-transition-*` pseudo-element.
